elements.description: Point-in-time help: a small film-frame icon to put beside a heading or label, opening one short tutorial in a modal player with captions and chapters.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The video's title – the tooltip, the player's heading and the icon's accessible name

properties.name: description
properties.description: A line or two about what it shows, under the player

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Its length in seconds, shown in the tooltip and the player

properties.name: src
properties.description: A video file the browser can play

properties.name: type
properties.description: The file's type, e.g. "video/mp4", when the URL doesn't say

properties.name: poster
properties.description: The player's picture before it plays

properties.name: captions
properties.description: A WebVTT captions file for `src`

properties.name: captionsLang
properties.description: The captions' language (default "en")

properties.name: embed
properties.description: An embed URL from a video host, played in an iframe instead of `src`

properties.name: chapters
properties.description: Points in the video to jump to (with `src`)

properties.name: label
properties.description: Words beside the icon, e.g. "Watch how"; unset, the icon stands alone with a tooltip

properties.name: size
properties.description: The icon's size against the text around it: "sm" (1em), "md" (1.25em, the default) or "lg" (1.5em)

properties.name: watched
properties.description: Whether it has been watched – a check on the icon. Set when a file plays to its end, unless a tc-watched-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the player is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: autoplay
properties.description: Start playing a file as soon as the player opens

properties.name: transcript
properties.description: The transcript's lines, `{ time, text }`. Unset, it's read from the `captions` file when first shown

properties.name: transcriptFile
properties.description: A transcript file to download instead of the text one made from the lines, e.g. a PDF

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Rename any of the words

properties.name: player
properties.description: The <video> in the open player, when it plays a file

properties.name: transcriptCues
properties.description: The transcript's lines: the ones given, or the ones read from the captions file

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The player was opened or closed ({ open }: HelpVideoOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

events.name: tc-watched-change
events.description: The video played to its end ({ watched }: HelpVideoWatchedChange); cancelable – prevented, `watched` stays as it was

functions.name: parseHelpVideoVtt
functions.description:
A WebVTT file's cues as transcript lines: each cue's start and its words, with tags such as <v Name> and <b>
removed and the lines of one cue joined. NOTE, STYLE and REGION blocks are skipped.

functions.name: helpVideoTranscriptText
functions.description: A transcript as plain text: the title, then each line with its time

functions.name: helpVideoTime
functions.description: m:ss, or h:mm:ss past an hour, from seconds

props.name: title
props.description: The video's title – the tooltip, the player's heading and the icon's accessible name

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the player is open – controlled when given

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The player was opened or closed

props.name: watched
props.description: Whether it has been watched – controlled when given

props.name: defaultWatched
props.description: Watched on mount when `watched` isn't controlled

props.name: onWatchedChange
props.description: The video played to its end

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
